description: Hackathon Agent Kit session lifecycle hooks: context injection, session event capture and learning handoff. Every hook is best-effort: failures are logged to stderr and the hook exits 0, so a hook never blocks a session.

SessionStart.description: Inject routing mode, current plan stage, top learnings and pending eval decisions

PostToolUse.description: Append tool events to logs/session-events.jsonl for the control plane

Stop.description: Close the session and clear the session marker
